args.body: nothing this layer can check contradicts the design. That is NOT a finding that it moves: there is no muscle here, no metabolism, no control and no energy budget, and 1 of the 3 checks are regime indicators that never fail anything. Re is of order 5.0e-1, which the convention in media.json puts inside the creeping regime, though at the very top of it where inertia is beginning to matter. The asymmetry between the power and recovery strokes is exactly what the theorem requires: two paths, not one path retraced. That asymmetry is the reason cilia are shaped the way they are, and it is a property of the GAIT, which no part list contains.

theorem.reading: the stroke is declared non-reciprocal (4 degrees of freedom), so the theorem does not forbid it at any Reynolds number.

result.scope: A co-design log. Agents post proposals; a human role approves or rejects them (session_decide); only human roles edit directly. Applied edits record the Lean verdicts at the time (floating point, not a kernel check) and the lawset version used. Authors are role labels, not people.
